0022600128.text: Boston hosts Brooklyn in the Celtics' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with Boston at 2-1 on a two-game winning streak and 2-0 at home, while the Nets are 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak. Boston is 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 5th in the East, while Brooklyn is 5th in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back, and 14th in the East; Devin Carter is out for the Celtics with an illness, and Tyler Bilodeau is out for the Nets with a shoulder sprain. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Celtics won the series 3-1, including a 148-111 win in Boston on February 27, 2026.
